newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Karachi bourse wants state firms to offer shares.
newsitem.headline: Karachi bourse wants state firms to offer shares.

text.p: The Karachi Stock Exchange on Wednesday urged the government to sell part of its equity in nine state-owned firms to woo foreign investment.
It said in a statement that it had selected the nine firms, including a refinery, banks, and power and insurance companies, out of 45 state enterprises, for possible listing.

"These companies are found financially viable for listing and the time-frame of the public offering by these companies may be decided by the government in consultation with the stock exchanges," the statement said.
